historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment.
National headquarters of the Japanese American Citizens League, the organisation founded in San Francisco in 1918 that led the campaign for redress for wartime internment.

unknowns: The assessor dates the building to 1975, after this photograph was taken.
The city's Japantown context statement gives the JACL's national headquarters here and also calls 1761-65 Post Street the site of that headquarters. It does not reconcile the two.
